- **Accredited Specialist:** Look for solicitors with a Law Society of NSW Accredited Specialist designation in personal injury or medical negligence law.
- **Fee Structure:** Confirm whether they operate on a **No Win, No Fee** basis, and understand if out-of-pocket disbursements (such as independent medical expert reports) are covered during the investigation phase.[[1]](https://burganlawyers.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/newcastle)[[3]](https://conradcurrylaw.com.au/medical-negligence-lawyers/)
